title: Protests and clashes at LPU after online rape claim the university denies

tea.why: Students protested after posts on Reddit claimed a female student had been raped and had died; the university says no such incident occurred.
tea.want: Answers and action over the alleged incident (specific demands are not detailed in the sources).
tea.changed: Oct 1: police arrested three people, including a student, over violence and property damage during the protests.

summary: Students at Lovely Professional University in Phagwara, Punjab, protested on September 27 after claims circulated on Reddit that a female student had been raped and had died. Protesters blocked the Delhi–Amritsar highway, and police and students clashed outside the campus; arson and ransacking on campus were reported. Police have registered cases and arrested three people, including an LPU student and two local residents, in connection with the violence. The university's founder and chancellor, BJP MP Ashok Kumar Mittal, said preliminary investigations found no such incident had taken place, called the claims false and alleged the protests were an organised conspiracy to destabilise Punjab.
demands: Action and transparency over the alleged incident
response: Police registered cases and arrested three people over the violence. The university's chancellor said preliminary investigations found the claims false and alleged an organised conspiracy.

arrests.text: three arrested, including one student, over the violence

updates.text: Students protested, blocked the Delhi–Amritsar highway and clashed with police outside the campus.
Police arrested three people, including a student, in connection with the violence.
The university's chancellor said no such incident took place and alleged a conspiracy.
